claims.text: Multi-SimLex covers 12 languages, including Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Welsh, and Kiswahili.
The languages included in Multi-SimLex are typologically diverse, featuring both widely used and low-resource languages.
The resource includes datasets annotated for semantic similarity across these 12 languages.
